scripts.check: bun run panda && bun run design && astro check && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: bun run scripts/require-no-skips.ts -- bun test src/games src/tests tests/content-and-results.test.ts tests/access-auth.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: bun run scripts/require-no-skips.ts -- vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: bun run scripts/require-no-skips.ts -- playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.build: bun run panda && bun run design && astro check && astro build && tsc --noEmit
scripts.deploy:dry-run: bun run build && bun run scripts/cloudflare-config.ts production --dry-run && wrangler deploy --config .wrangler/deploy-production.json --dry-run
scripts.deploy:preview: bun run build && bun run scripts/cloudflare-config.ts preview --dry-run && wrangler deploy --config .wrangler/deploy-preview.json --dry-run
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run scripts/deploy-cloudflare.ts production
scripts.db:migrate:remote: bun run scripts/cloudflare-config.ts production --provision && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config .wrangler/deploy-production.json
scripts.design: bun run scripts/require-no-skips.ts -- bun test src/tests/design-tokens.test.ts
